title: docs: stop teaching keys the strict authoring face refuses (objectui#12131, phase 1)
body:
Part of #12131
Clause-②: no

Phase 1 only. Phase 2, widening the scan surface of `scripts/check-doc-json-fences.mjs` to the published READMEs, has not started: that script arrives with PR objectui#12127, which is still open and unmerged. `git ls-tree` on fresh `origin/main` (`c9fc10b1`) lists nothing for it (control leg `scripts/check-doc-links.mjs`: 1 entry). This branch neither stacks on #12127 nor creates the script.

## What changed

**Interface blocks (`content/docs/components/form`).** Each block now lists only keys the node schema declares. Every removal was measured through the real `SchemaRenderer` plus the registry at the base commit `10713937`, by rendering with and without the key:

| page | removed | reading | declared key written instead |
|---|---|---|---|
| `button.mdx` | `fullWidth` | byte-identical render | `className` comment now names `"w-full"`, the spelling the page's own `full-width-button` fixture uses |
| `button.mdx` | `href` | byte-identical render (not in the button's closed DOM whitelist) | none. Navigation is an `action:button` node, which the block's `onClick` comment already says |
| `form.mdx` | `submitButton` | submit text stays "Submit", only a stray `submitbutton` DOM attribute | `submitLabel` (submit text measured "Send it") |
| `form.mdx` | FormField `defaultValue` | byte-identical render | FormSchema `defaultValues` (input value measured "PRESET-VALUE") |
| `label.mdx` | `required` | only a stray `required` attribute on the label element, no indicator | none. LabelSchema declares no indicator key |

`href` and FormField `defaultValue` were not in the card's list. They sit in the same blocks and are the same defect (undeclared and unread), so they are fixed here under the bounded in-place rule: same defect class, a mechanical removal, files already in this claim, and the same gates. All three edited blocks still compile on their own under `tsc --strict` (a control with a deliberate type error fails).

**Catalog fixture.** `components-form-label/required-label.json` is now `password-label.json`, because it shows a label paired with a password input and draws no required indicator. The generated index was regenerated with `pnpm --filter @object-ui/example-schema-catalog regenerate`. The objectui#8761 pin and the label page follow the new id, and the page's "Required Field" heading becomes "With a Password Input" so the page stops making the same promise. `git grep required-label` now returns nothing.

**README examples.** All three are **repaired**, so none is a declared fragment:

| fence | strict-face refusal on main | repair |
|---|---|---|
| root `README.md`, Contact Form | undeclared root `title` (at runtime only a native tooltip on the form element) | `title` dropped. Measured: 4 fields (text, email, select, textarea), required markers, submit "Send Message" |
| root `README.md`, Dashboard | `statistic` / `chart` are not widget types in `widgets[]`; `label`, `value`, `trend`, `w`, `h`, `chartType` undeclared there; undeclared root `title` | see below |
| `packages/plugin-dashboard/README.md`, object-bound table | `table` is the static component: `data` required, `objectName` undeclared, column `format` not on the static surface | `"type": "object-data-table"`, the node the dashboard renders an object-bound table as, plus one lead-in sentence saying why a bare `table` does not fit |

### The Dashboard example: two rulings, one shape

The 2026-09-01 ruling on objectui#7115 (maintainer-approved, comment `5494799307`) set this example's content to four `statistic` tiles whose `${stats.*}` values evaluate, and it rejected spelling the numbers out. A pin in `scripts/__tests__/check-doc-component-types.test.ts` holds that ruling ("the flagship dashboard example teaches `statistic`, and keeps its expressions"). Since then the dashboard's `widgets[]` slot has closed, and the strict face refuses a `statistic` entry there. Measured on main: the example as written renders six "chart type is not supported yet" panels. No tile draws and no expression evaluates.

This PR keeps the four ruled tiles byte-for-byte (`label`, the `${stats.*}` `value`, `trend`, `description`) and changes only their container, from `dashboard` to `grid` with `columns: 4`. That shape passes strict, each tile draws its evaluated value (measured: `EVAL-REV` drawn from a `PredicateScopeProvider` scope), and the #7115 pin stays unchanged and green. It drops three things: the undeclared root `title`, the flat `w`/`h`, and the two charts, which had no data and drew only the "not supported" panel. A one-line lead-in points readers to the plugin-dashboard README for the `dashboard` node and dataset charts.

⚠️ The branch history shows the alternative. Commit `7ba0fe0a` first rewrote the example as a `dashboard` with `metric-card` entries holding literal values, dataset-bound `line`/`pie` widgets and `layout` boxes, and `dfda40fa` declared those three values in `DOC_TYPE_EXEMPTIONS`. That variant reverses the #7115 ruling: `metric-card` has no carriage row, which was measured (a `${stats.revenue}` value renders literally). It was therefore reverted (`74a3bead`) and replaced (`e7d0ebce`). The net diff touches no script. If the seat wants this example to use the `dashboard` node, that reversal needs a ruling first.

## Premise re-derivation (the card's enumeration)

- **"Four refused JSON node documents outside `content/docs`": falsified as stated.** I applied #12127's gate predicate (json/jsonc fence, parses, plain object with a string `type`, `type` names an arm, blockquoted fences read) to every tracked `.md`/`.mdx` outside `content/docs`. At base it found **19** refused documents. Three are the in-scope README fences and one is the `docs/audits` record, which was left untouched as triage ruled. The other 15 are 5 historical records (CHANGELOGs and a changeset), 9 fences in the published `skills/` tree (all but one are labelled counter-examples), and 1 deliberate counter-example in `packages/components/src/renderers/complex/README-KANBAN.md`, which is not in that package's `files`. After this PR the count is 16, and none of the 16 is in this claim's surface.
- **The declared equivalents** (`className: "w-full"`, `submitLabel`, no indicator key on `label`): verified against the schema and through the renderer.
- **Key counts on main:** `fullWidth` ×1 in `button.mdx`, `submitButton` ×1 in `form.mdx`, `required` ×2 in `label.mdx`. Of the last two, one is in the interface block and one is the fixture id, and both changed.

## Verification, at `e7d0ebce`

Every exit code was captured by redirecting output first and reading the code after, never through a pipe. Each verdict below is the gate's own printed line.

| command | exit |
|---|---|
| `node scripts/check-doc-links.mjs` | 0, "Links are valid across 17 scan roots." |
| `node scripts/check-doc-component-types.mjs` | 0, "Every documented component type is registered." |
| `node scripts/check-prompt-component-keys.mjs` | 0 |
| `node scripts/check-doc-fence-languages.mjs --self-test` and plain run | 0 / 0 |
| `node scripts/check-doc-example-ids.mjs` | 0, "415 real reference(s) all resolve in the catalog registry." |
| `node scripts/check-new-cross-file-line-citations.mjs` | 0, "0 new citation(s)" |
| `node scripts/check-control-bytes.mjs` | 0 |
| `node scripts/check-shell-escape-residue.mjs` | 0 |
| `node scripts/check-changeset-presence.mjs` | 0, "no changeset is owed" |
| `python3 scripts/regenerate-catalog-index.py --check` | 0, "up to date (433 entries)" |
| `pnpm exec vitest run scripts/__tests__/` | 0, 179 files passed, 2 skipped |
| `pnpm exec vitest run packages/types/` | 0, 368 files passed |
| `pnpm exec vitest run examples/schema-catalog/` | 0, 42 files passed |
| `pnpm exec vitest run packages/plugin-dashboard/` | 0, 174 files passed |
| 8 further tests that read the README, docs or catalog trees (components, core, cli, plugin-gantt, plugin-detail) | 0, 8 files passed |
| `tsc --noEmit -p examples/schema-catalog/tsconfig.json --listFiles` | 0, with `password-label.json` and `index.ts` in the program |
| eslint on the 2 changed `.ts`/`.tsx` files | 0, 2 files, 0 errors |

On an earlier head, `scripts/__tests__/` was red on exactly one test: the #7115 pin, against the `metric-card` variant. That red is what surfaced the ruling.

Lint narrowing: eslint answers "File ignored because no matching configuration was supplied" for the changed `.md`, `.mdx` and `.json` files, so its population is the two `.ts`/`.tsx` files. The `--format json` output counts 2 files. The resolved config sets neither `parserOptions.project` nor `projectService`, so this diff cannot move eslint's verdict on any file it does not touch.

NOT MEASURED locally, left to CI:
- `check:doc-snippets` as a whole. Its `--build-filter` closure is nearly every package, too heavy for the foreground limit. The three `ts` interface blocks it reads in this diff were compiled on their own (see above).
- The catalog's `tsconfig.test.json`, which resolves about 15 unbuilt workspace packages. The only change it sees is one string in an `as const` id tuple.
- lychee `check-links`. This diff adds one relative link, which `check-doc-links` resolves.
- `check:readme-exports`, which needs the full package build. This diff adds no import to any README.

## Acceptance notes

- **Strict face, `custom` dashboard widget.** The `component` arm for any other registered node accepts only base keys under strict. `{ "type": "dashboard", "widgets": [{ "id": "w", "type": "custom", "component": { "type": "text", "content": "hi" } }] }` has strict=false and tolerant=true, while the TypeScript face types `component` as any `SchemaNode`. This is reported to the seat, not fixed here.
- **`skills/objectui/rules/protocol.md`.** The fence labelled "✅ CORRECT" (a `data-table` with `columns` and no `data`) is refused by both faces. `skills/**` is a governed surface, so this is reported to the seat.
- **Phase 2.** Once the scan surface covers package READMEs, `README-KANBAN.md`'s refused-by-name `onCardMove` document is a deliberate counter-example and would need the gate's fragment marker, if that file is in the surface at all. It is not shipped.
- No changeset: `check-changeset-presence` says none is owed (package READMEs are excluded from the published-source rule).
